overloadMerges.note: value is documented with the '←' arrow (returned by the command), not '→'; auto-parse defaulted it to direction 'in'. Its four documented meanings are recorded as sentinelValues/description rather than a bare Integer.

params.name: subtotal
params.description: Subtotal (break) level, between 1 and the number of subtotals/sorts

params.name: value
params.description: Spacing configured below the subtotal row

sentinelValues.meaning: No space added below the subtotal row

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Retrieves the spacing configured below a given subtotal (break) row of a list-mode report: 0 for none, 32000 for a page break, a positive number of pixels, or a negative percentage of the subtotal row's height.

constraints: Applies only to list mode reports.
A positive value expresses the spacing in pixels; a negative value expresses it as a percentage of the subtotal row (e.g. -100 means 100% of the row's height).
